name: Shiga Youko
source:
A genuine career woman, she is the female head of the planning and development department at the head office of Paris Dame, a rapidly growing boutique.

She is especially close to the president's wife, Reimi, and is a hard worker who has achieved steadfast results through hard work in order to avoid being told that her current position is due to her connections.

She married the protagonist, who has nothing to offer, in a surprise move that surprised everyone around her. After marriage, she leaves the house in her husband's hands and works hard, but that often means she cannot go home at night.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=347165]getchu[/url]]
